tasks.title: Media-quality baseline + permanence census

tasks.currentBehavior: QUALITY-BASELINE.json records real measurements of the published reel + source clips + census
tasks.businessImpact: Every later quality claim is now falsifiable against a ruler
tasks.creativeImpact: Named the 3 dominant defects: dead air, identity drift, safe-zone violations

tasks.title: Canonical media asset registry (media_assets, 0088)
tasks.problem: Media truth is scattered across reel_jobs payloads, provider URLs, local paths, inventory JSON, and git-committed binaries; nothing has identity, checksum, lineage, or lifecycle
tasks.currentBehavior: storagePut returns a URL that nobody records durably; assets have no versions
tasks.desiredBehavior: Every produced asset registered with checksum, lineage, lifecycle, rights, Drive-sync state; one current version per logical output
tasks.businessImpact: Asset permanence + reuse become possible; duplicate spend detectable
tasks.creativeImpact: Lineage enables repair-without-regeneration and creative-memory over real assets
tasks.operatorImpact: Registry is the substrate for the media library UI
acceptanceCriteria: invariants enforced in service (immutable versions, checksum required, no archive claim without verified copy)
reel assembly + carousel renderer register their outputs
0088 journaled + apply script ready (prod DDL awaits operator tap)
evidenceRequired: registered rows from a real assembly in dev

tasks.title: Google Drive Creative Vault (drive.file scope, refresh-token pattern)
tasks.problem: No durable human-accessible archive; the only permanent copies of published media are accidental git commits
tasks.desiredBehavior: CreativeVaultService: root workspace + campaign folders (stable IDs), idempotent verified uploads with appProperties (assetId, checksum), manifest per campaign, reconciliation; restricted sharing by default
tasks.businessImpact: Every valuable asset permanently preserved and operator-browsable
tasks.operatorImpact: One-time consent click on /api/oauth/drive/start (uses existing GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET already on prod)
acceptanceCriteria: repeat upload does not duplicate (idempotency key)
evidenceRequired: integration tests with mocked Drive API
live smoke after operator grant: real folder + file IDs
remainingRisk: operator consent is the live-path gate; until then vault runs in tests only

tasks.title: First real generation->QA->repair->archive trajectory
tasks.problem: Rendered QA + selective repair + registry + vault have never run end-to-end on one real asset
tasks.desiredBehavior: One campaign: render -> runRenderedQa real verdict -> requestBeatRepair -> worker repair -> re-eval -> registry versions -> Drive archive -> reconciliation clean -> forensic reconstruction
tasks.creativeImpact: First before/after repair comparison against baseline
tasks.operatorImpact: Spends render credits; needs deployed M2/M3 + Drive grant
acceptanceCriteria: repair creates new version, old preserved
archive gate passes with checksum verification
evidenceRequired: job IDs, asset IDs, Drive file IDs, before/after contact sheets, cost records

tasks.title: Root-cause and fix the 15s dead-air defect in reel assembly
tasks.problem: Published reel 30008 is silent from 7.1s to 22.0s (68% of runtime) — VO+music end while video continues
tasks.rootCause: TWO graph length bugs: (1) sidechaincompress ENDS ITS OUTPUT when the KEY input (the VO, 7.1s) ends — the ducked music was truncated at VO-end and apad filled the rest with digital silence; (2) a bed shorter than the reel died at bed-end the same way. CORRECTION: the initial 'assets/reel-music does not exist' hypothesis was WRONG (an ls from a reset cwd) — CC0 beds existed since #253 (2026-06-20) and were deployed at render time; the graph killed them.
tasks.currentBehavior: FIXED on-branch: sidechain key silence-padded to the full timeline; beds looped (aloop) before trim; deterministic dead-air gate (silencedetect on the ACTUAL render, gaps >=2.5s inside the timeline refuse the render) beside the frozen-frame gate; encode now stereo 192k
tasks.businessImpact: Dead-air reels read as broken content to viewers
affectedCallers: reelAssembly buildFfmpegArgs audio graph + assembleReel post-render gate
acceptanceCriteria: silencedetect on final render finds no in-timeline gap >=2.5s below -35dB
evidenceRequired: server/reelAudioIntegrity.test.ts real-render trajectory: the previously-fatal shape (2s VO + 4s bed on a 9s timeline) renders with ZERO dead-air gaps and 2-channel audio
remainingRisk: not yet deployed — first prod render after merge is the live confirmation
audio naturalness still unmeasured (no listening pass)

tasks.title: /generated/* must 404 on missing files, not serve SPA HTML
tasks.problem: Missing media URLs answer 200 text/html via the SPA catch-all — masks data loss from every monitor and from Meta
tasks.currentBehavior: express.static falls through to SPA fallback
tasks.businessImpact: Monitors and integrations can finally see media loss
evidenceRequired: post-deploy: curl -sI nickstire.org/generated/definitely-not-real-xyz123.mp4 returns 404 (the baseline's control URL); curl -sI /generated/reel-30008.mp4 still 200 video/mp4
remainingRisk: verified by mount-order reasoning (express.static next()s on miss into the sibling handler); live probe owed post-deploy with the exact baseline control URL

tasks.title: Remove 62MB of committed media from git AFTER vault archival proves copies
tasks.problem: 19 media files (62MB) committed to git bloat every clone/build and are currently the ONLY copies of the published reel master
tasks.desiredBehavior: Copies verified in Drive vault (+ registry rows), then files removed from git + data/generated gitignored
tasks.businessImpact: Repo hygiene; but removal BEFORE archival would destroy the only master copies
acceptanceCriteria: Drive fileIds + checksum match recorded in registry BEFORE git rm
evidenceRequired: reconciliation report showing synced state for all 19
remainingRisk: ORDER MATTERS: archive first, delete second
